title: How the self-assessment score is calculated
title_sw: Jinsi alama ya tathmini binafsi inavyohesabiwa
body: Each answer carries points. Single-choice questions give the points of the selected option. Multiple-choice questions give points according to how many boxes you tick. Free-text questions carry no points. Your total is divided by the maximum of the questions that applied to you and expressed as a percentage. Questions hidden by your earlier answers do not count towards the maximum.
body_sw: Kila jibu lina alama. Maswali ya chaguo moja hutoa alama za chaguo lililochaguliwa. Maswali ya chaguo nyingi hutoa alama kulingana na idadi ya visanduku ulivyochagua. Maswali ya maandishi huru hayana alama. Jumla yako inagawanywa kwa kiwango cha juu cha maswali yaliyokuhusu na kuonyeshwa kama asilimia.

title: What the letters A to E mean
title_sw: Herufi A hadi E zinamaanisha nini
body: The letter summarises your percentage: A from 80 %, B from 60 %, C from 40 %, D from 20 %, and E below 20 %. The same thresholds apply to each topic and to the overall result. A letter is a snapshot of practices at the time of the assessment, not a ranking against other companies.
body_sw: Herufi inatoa muhtasari wa asilimia yako: A kuanzia 80 %, B kuanzia 60 %, C kuanzia 40 %, D kuanzia 20 %, na E chini ya 20 %. Vigezo hivi hivi vinatumika kwa kila mada na kwa matokeo ya jumla.

title: Why a past result keeps its letter when the methodology changes
title_sw: Kwa nini matokeo ya zamani yanabaki na herufi yake mkakati unapobadilika
body: Every assessment is stored together with the methodology version it was completed on. When a new version is published, past results are not re-scored. They keep their letter and their version label until the company completes a new assessment. The version and date are shown in the 'Why this score' panel.
body_sw: Kila tathmini huhifadhiwa pamoja na toleo la mbinu ilipokamilishwa. Toleo jipya linapochapishwa, matokeo ya zamani hayahesabiwi upya.

title: How the roadmap is built
body: The roadmap is generated by rules written by the methodology team. Each rule looks at one question and fires when the answer scored at or below a set level. Each step is placed in a phase (now, next or later) with a priority and an effort estimate, and shows the answer that triggered it. No step is invented by a model: every step points to a recommendation in the published library.
body_sw: Ramani ya njia inaundwa na kanuni zilizoandikwa na timu ya mbinu. Kila kanuni inaangalia swali moja na huanza kazi wakati jibu lilipata alama ya kiwango fulani au chini yake.

title: Marketing topic: what is assessed
body: The marketing topic looks at whether the company has a responsible marketing policy covering children, which age threshold it uses, which channels it covers and whether compliance is checked. Points are lost most often for a missing age threshold, for channels left out of the policy (especially digital media and schools) and for the absence of any compliance review.
body_sw: Mada ya masoko inaangalia kama kampuni ina sera ya masoko yenye uwajibikaji inayohusu watoto, kikomo gani cha umri inatumia, njia zipi inahusu na kama ufuasi hukaguliwa.

title: Products and management topic: what is assessed
body: This topic covers whether a nutrition strategy exists and is approved, what it covers, and how much of the portfolio has been assessed with a nutrient profiling model. Free-text answers about recent reformulation are read by reviewers but do not score.

title: Workforce topic: what is assessed
body: The workforce topic asks whether a workforce nutrition programme exists, at how many sites, and which elements it includes: healthier food at work, nutrition education, breastfeeding support and basic health checks.

title: Labelling topic: what is assessed
body: Labelling covers back-of-pack nutrient declarations on all products and the front-of-pack information provided: interpretive labels, per-portion information, a claims policy and allergen highlighting.
body_sw: Uwekaji lebo unahusu matamko ya virutubisho nyuma ya kifungashio kwenye bidhaa zote na taarifa zinazotolewa mbele ya kifungashio.

title: Engagement topic: what is assessed
body: Engagement looks at participation in national nutrition policy processes and at which stakeholders the company works with on nutrition: government, industry associations, civil society, research institutions and investors.

title: Can I change an answer after finishing?
title_sw: Je, naweza kubadilisha jibu baada ya kumaliza?
body: Yes. Open the assessment again, change the answer and submit. A new result is stored with a new date; the earlier result stays in your history.
body_sw: Ndiyo. Fungua tathmini tena, badilisha jibu na uwasilishe. Matokeo mapya huhifadhiwa na tarehe mpya; matokeo ya awali yanabaki kwenye historia yako.

title: Does my assessment continue if I lose the internet connection?
title_sw: Je, tathmini yangu inaendelea nikipoteza mtandao?
body: Yes. Answers are saved on your device as you go. When the connection returns, they are synchronised and you can continue where you stopped. You see a notice while you are offline.
body_sw: Ndiyo. Majibu huhifadhiwa kwenye kifaa chako unapoendelea. Mtandao ukirudi, yanasawazishwa na unaweza kuendelea ulipoishia.

title: Who can see my answers?
body: Your answers are visible to you, to the analysts who maintain the assessment and to administrators. Content and methodology editors cannot see individual company answers. Investors see only aggregated results of companies that have opted in to sharing; policymakers see country-level aggregates and never individual companies.
body_sw: Majibu yako yanaonekana kwako na kwa wachambuzi wanaosimamia tathmini. Wahariri wa maudhui hawawezi kuona majibu ya kampuni.

title: What does 'share with investors' mean?
body: If you opt in, your topic letters and roadmap phases appear in the investor view together with other consenting companies. Individual answers and free-text are never shown there. You can withdraw consent at any time in your account.

title: How do I download my roadmap as a PDF?
title_sw: Ninawezaje kupakua ramani ya njia kama PDF?
body: Open the roadmap and choose 'Print or save as PDF'. The print view removes navigation and keeps the phases, steps and the answers behind each step.
body_sw: Fungua ramani ya njia na uchague 'Chapisha au hifadhi kama PDF'.

title: Is the assessment available in Swahili?
body: Yes. Switch the language at the top of the page. All questions are available in Swahili; about half of the recommendations are translated so far, the rest fall back to English and every Swahili text is marked as a draft translation awaiting native review.
body_sw: Ndiyo. Badilisha lugha juu ya ukurasa. Maswali yote yanapatikana kwa Kiswahili; takriban nusu ya mapendekezo yametafsiriwa, mengine yanaonyeshwa kwa Kiingereza, na tafsiri zote ni rasimu.

title: Why was a question hidden?
body: Some questions only appear when an earlier answer makes them relevant. For example, the age threshold question appears only if you said you have a responsible marketing policy. Hidden questions do not count towards your maximum.

title: How long does the assessment take?
body: The assessment usually takes about 20 to 30 minutes. You can stop and continue later; progress is saved automatically.
body_sw: Tathmini kwa kawaida huchukua dakika 20 hadi 30. Unaweza kusimama na kuendelea baadaye.

title: What counts as a nutrient profiling model
body: A nutrient profiling model is a published method that classifies foods by nutritional composition, usually per 100 g. National authorities and international bodies publish such models. The assessment does not prescribe a specific model; it asks whether one has been applied to your products.

title: What a responsible marketing policy usually contains
body: Typical elements: the products that may or may not be marketed to children, the age used to define a child, the channels covered (television, radio, digital and social media, schools, sponsorship, packaging, influencers), and how compliance is monitored and reported.

title: Why digital channels matter in a marketing policy
body: Children often see food advertising on video platforms and social media as well as on television. Policies limited to broadcast media leave those channels uncovered, which is why the channels question gives a point for each channel included.

title: Compliance review versus independent audit
body: An internal review is a regular self-check of campaigns against the policy. An independent audit is carried out by an external party that reports its findings. The assessment awards more points for independent audits because they are more credible to regulators and investors.

title: Starting a workforce nutrition programme
body: A realistic first step is one site, a healthier canteen or snack offer, and two education sessions a year. Breastfeeding support (time and a private space) costs little to set up. Measure participation from the start.

title: Back-of-pack nutrient declarations
body: A full declaration lists at least energy, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugars, protein and salt per 100 g or 100 ml. Values should come from laboratory analysis or a recognised food composition database and be checked periodically.

title: Front-of-pack information
body: Front-of-pack information helps shoppers compare products quickly. Options include interpretive labels, per-portion energy information, a policy limiting health and nutrition claims, and clear allergen highlighting. Where a national scheme exists, the assessment expects it to be used.

title: Engaging in policy processes constructively
body: Joining public consultations and standards committees is counted positively when the company's positions are public and support measurable nutrition improvements. The assessment does not evaluate the content of positions, only participation and transparency.

title: How recommendations are matched to answers
body: Each scored question has a recommendation for every score it can produce. The one matching your exact score is shown. Fixed recommendations are shown whatever you answered. Methodology editors cannot publish a version where a possible score has no recommendation.

title: Methodology versions and publication
body: Methodology editors work in a draft version. Before publishing, the hub checks that every score has a recommendation, that every question has translations, that dependencies are valid and shows how many past results would have a different letter. Publishing records who published, when and why.

title: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
body: Your account and answers are removed from the active system. Aggregated country statistics that were already published are not affected because they contain no individual data. The retention period is shown under “My account” and set by administrators.

title: Can I download my data?
body: Yes. In your account, choose 'Download my data' to receive your profile, answers and results as a JSON file.
body_sw: Ndiyo. Katika akaunti yako, chagua 'Pakua data yangu' ili kupokea wasifu wako, majibu na matokeo kama faili ya JSON.

title: Is the nutrition score calculator an official result?
title_sw: Je, kikokotoo cha alama za lishe ni matokeo rasmi?
body: No. The calculator is an illustrative tool to compare two recipes under a published front-of-pack algorithm. It is not an official rating of any organisation and not a medical or dietary recommendation.
body_sw: Hapana. Kikokotoo ni zana ya kielelezo ya kulinganisha mapishi mawili. Si tathmini rasmi ya shirika lolote na si ushauri wa kitabibu au wa lishe.

title: How the calculator's points work
body: Energy, sugars, saturated fat and salt add unfavourable points per 100 g. Fibre, protein and the share of fruit, vegetables and legumes add favourable points. When unfavourable points reach 11, protein no longer counts for general foods. The final number maps to a letter.

title: Who answers questions the assistant cannot?
body: When the assistant finds no published source for a question, it offers to send the question to the hub team. The team answers within the admin queue and can publish the answer as a new FAQ entry so that future users find it directly.

title: Does the assistant give health or dietary advice?
title_sw: Je, msaidizi anatoa ushauri wa afya au lishe?
body: No. The assistant only explains your assessment results, the methodology and how to use the hub. Questions about personal health, diets or medical conditions are declined and can be passed to a human.
body_sw: Hapana. Msaidizi anaelezea tu matokeo ya tathmini yako, mbinu na jinsi ya kutumia jukwaa. Maswali kuhusu afya binafsi au mlo hukataliwa.

title: Reading the 'Why this score' panel
body: The panel lists each question that applied to you with the answer, the points achieved, the maximum, and the formula used: total points divided by maximum points, as a percentage, mapped to the letter thresholds. It also shows the methodology version and the date of calculation.

title: Which countries are covered?
body: Kenya and Tanzania are active. Nigeria, Senegal, Indonesia and Bangladesh are planned; administrators can add a country by copying the methodology and marking national thresholds for later review.
body_sw: Kenya na Tanzania zinatumika. Nigeria, Senegal, Indonesia na Bangladesh zimepangwa.
